about.title: About
about.body: ClaudeInFinance lists AI agent use cases for finance. Each skill describes a business goal and provides a structured prompt to copy into Claude. The goal is simple: help analysts, controllers, auditors and investors get the most out of AI agents in their daily work.
about.disclaimer: This site is an independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic.

aboutPage.title: Learn AI applied to finance, seriously.
aboutPage.mission: ClaudeInFinance is an education initiative that helps finance students and professionals master AI: build their own agents, automate their workflows and develop directly applicable skills.
aboutPage.methodBody: Theory, demonstration, exercise, project, verification. We insist on human validation, confidentiality and reliability of results, because finance does not tolerate guesswork.
aboutPage.toolsTitle: Third-party tools, not a black box
aboutPage.toolsBody: We teach how to use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, n8n or Python. No proprietary runtime: you learn transferable skills.
aboutPage.fdBody: ClaudeInFinance is the education initiative of Forward & Deploy, which supports companies, banks, funds and schools on AI applied to finance.
